title: Identifying Climate-Induced Groundwater Depletion in GRACE Observations
datasets: GRACE JPL-RL05.1 monthly gravity solutions (67 coefficients, October 2003-December 2015)
SNODAS daily snow-water equivalent (1 km, spatially upscaled to 0.5 degree and temporally interpolated to monthly)
PRISM Climate Group monthly gridded precipitation and minimum, maximum and mean temperature
USGS groundwater-use reports for 2000, 2005, 2010 and 2015, temporally interpolated and county values spatially weighted to 0.5 degree grids
USGS National Map reservoir inventory used to exclude 0.5 degree cells containing large reservoirs
Soil-moisture, surface-water/runoff and total-water-storage anomaly components used in the mass-balance decomposition

study_area_verified.name: 0.5 degree GRACE land-grid analysis over the United States; exact grid subset is not specified in the supplied excerpt
study_area_verified.study_period: October 2003 through December 2015 for the GRACE JPL-RL05.1 series; the anomaly baseline is January 2004 through December 2009.
study_area_verified.analysis_grid: GRACE-derived terrestrial water storage anomalies and auxiliary fields aggregated to 0.5 degree cells; cells containing large reservoirs were excluded.

anchor_use_verified.role: GRACE terrestrial water storage anomaly is the gravimetric total-water-storage input from which groundwater storage anomaly is separated by mass balance.
anchor_use_verified.evidence: The supplied Methods use JPL-RL05.1 GRACE monthly gravity coefficients, form gridded TWSA, and subtract soil-moisture, snow-water-equivalent and surface-water components to obtain groundwater storage anomaly.
corrections: The previous datasets field listed only GRACE and GRACE-FO and omitted SNODAS, PRISM, USGS groundwater-use and reservoir-mask inputs.
The task prompt now describes the catalog's historical Release 05 land mass-grid product rather than a generic GRACE/GRACE-FO product.

not_available_as_identified_source: JPL-RL05.1 spherical-harmonic coefficient files and the paper's gridding/post-processing workflow
SNODAS SWE fields as used by the paper
PRISM monthly climate grids as used by the paper
USGS groundwater-use reports and National Map reservoir exclusion mask
Paper-specific soil-moisture, runoff and surface-water anomaly realizations

anchor_use_verified.sibling_task_boundary: Admission requires operational use of GRACE land mass-grid or equivalent terrestrial-water-storage solutions. GRACE-FO-only studies do not satisfy the anchor; the deprecated Release 05 record is retained because it matches the paper's RL05.1 processing generation.

idea.research_question: 在持续、近似恒定抽水条件下，GRACE/GRACE-FO是否只能识别含水层初期的地下水储量下降，而无法识别由水平补给（capture）补偿抽水的准平衡阶段地下水流动变化？
idea.hypothesis: 若抽水速率在时间上保持近似稳定，则地下水系统会先出现由去水引起的储量下降和漏斗状降深；随后在Dupuit水平流与侧向补给逐步补偿抽水后，GRACE/GRACE-FO观测到的地下水储量异常将趋于零或接近零。换言之，GRACE对“储量变化”敏感，但对仅表现为流场重分配的capture过程不敏感。
idea.mechanism: 持续抽水首先导致井周围含水层去水，形成降深漏斗并引起地下水储量下降；随着时间推进，区域侧向地下水流入增强，capture逐步补偿抽水体积，使局地储量变化减弱并进入准平衡。该过程中，中间变量包括抽水速率、含水层可压缩性、水平水力梯度、侧向补给通量与地下水储量异常；GRACE/GRACE-FO只响应后者，而不直接响应流动重分配本身。

key_variables.target: 地下水储量异常（Groundwater Storage Anomaly, GWSA）或总水储量异常（TWSA）中扣除土壤水、地表水和积雪后的地下水分量
predictors: 地下水抽水速率（井群/灌溉区年度或月度抽水量）
GRACE/GRACE-FO mascon陆地水储量异常（约0.5°空间分辨率，月尺度）
土壤湿度与蒸散发（用于剥离气候驱动，优先采用GLDAS/ERA5陆面变量）
降水（用于控制补给变化）
含水层水文地质参数（导水率、贮水系数、厚度）
河流/灌渠水位或地表水体变化（用于表征侧向补给与capture）

data_sources: GRACE/GRACE-FO mascon陆地水储量产品（RL06类产品，月尺度，约0.5°空间分辨率，2002年至今）
地下水抽水统计或井观测资料（月度/年度，研究区尺度；可来自区域水资源管理部门或井网记录）
GLDAS或ERA5陆面变量（0.25°-0.5°，月尺度；土壤湿度、蒸散发、降水，用于分解气候信号）
研究区地下水位/孔隙水压监测井资料（逐日到月尺度，作为GRACE解释和验证数据）
idea.analytical_approach: 采用基于水量平衡的分量剥离框架：先用GLDAS/ERA5的土壤湿度、雪水当量、地表水与蒸散发校正GRACE/GRACE-FO TWSA，得到地下水储量异常；再结合抽水序列建立时滞回归或状态空间模型，检验“初期储量下降-后期准平衡”两阶段响应。建议使用分段回归或贝叶斯变点检测识别从dewatering向capture主导的转折点，并用5折交叉验证比较含抽水项与不含抽水项模型的解释力。若研究采用空间尺度聚合，可按流域/含水层单元做月尺度异常标准化，设置1-3个月滞后窗口评估抽水响应。
idea.expected_contribution: 把GRACE可观测的地下水变化限定到“储量变化”而非“流动变化”的物理边界上，建立抽水情景下GRACE信号可探测性的判别框架。该设计有助于区分短期去水造成的储量损失与长期capture导致的流场重分配，为地下水遥感监测的解释边界提供定量约束。
idea.falsification_condition: 若在抽水速率稳定（月变异系数<10%）且气候补给已校正后，GRACE/GRACE-FO地下水储量异常仍持续显著偏离零，例如连续6个月满足|GWSA|>1个标准差或线性趋势仍小于-1 cm/yr并与抽水变化无显著时滞响应（p>0.05），则“GRACE仅响应初期储量下降、对capture不敏感”的假设被证伪。
